csv_project_name: Design for New Radio Tower Facility
csv_scope_of_work: County of Sabine is soliciting sealed bids from qualified and licensed contractors for the turn-key design, engineering, and structural construction of a new radio tower facility. The scope includes, but is not limited to: Tower Fabrication & Erection: Supply and structural assembly of a 300-Foot Self-Supporting / Guyed antenna tower. Site and Civil Preparation: Grading, fencing, and installation of concrete foundations based. Appurtenances: Installation of six antennas and coaxial cable. Reattachment Phase: Relocate antenna and microwave from Pineland water tower to the new tower
